```sql
SELECT 
    sum(
        CASE 
            WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * fx.aud_nzd_rate
            ELSE l.line_total
        END
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' 
  AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
  AND o.order_status != 'CANCELLED';
```
